spec_match.rationale: The page now teaches the spec's XRDepthStateInit.depthTypeRequest sequence (verified against the immersive-web depth-sensing draft IDL) and shows the session.depthType read-back, but it remains a recommendation lookup that never probes a real XR surface on the visitor's device.

interactive.rationale: After un-escaping the inline script both dropdowns genuinely re-render the snippet, the four-row matrix, and the bytes/frame + latency stats (driven via CDP: scene-mesh + Vision Pro produced cpu-optimized/float32/1200 KB), but the interactivity is a config-table lookup, not an invocation of the depth-sensing API.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The promised knobs-plus-bandwidth-bill recommendation now actually renders and updates.

edge_cases.rationale: Still no navigator.xr feature detection, no unsupported-device handling, and no honest banner about where depthTypeRequest is actually available.

references.rationale: The ChromeStatus link now points to feature/5074096916004864, verified live via the chromestatus API (the old 5142732881981440 returned 404), restoring the slug-recovery self-heal.

conformance.rationale: Unchanged feature-level suite: it checks interface existence but asserts nothing about this concept page's contract (existing suites are immutable; not touched).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CDP: load populates snippet/matrix/stats, changing both selects updates all readouts, console clean (only the environmental fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet failure), no horizontal overflow at 1280x1600 or 360x740 DPR3, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: The page still records no showcaseTelemetry asserts, so production telemetry cannot see it working or failing.

design_system.rationale: .matrix td.best is now var(--text-black) on var(--accent-emerald) (#000 on #0a8f5c ~ 5.1:1, AA for its 0.78rem text; computed styles verified rgb(0,0,0) on rgb(10,143,92)), and the recommendation pane got min-width:0 + overflow-x:auto so the wide table scrolls inside its own container.

accessibility.rationale: Native selects with meaningful accessible names ('WebXR use case', 'Target device'), the table labelled 'Recommended depth-sensing configuration', and the recommendation pane is now an aria-live=polite region so select changes are announced.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1600 (mouse) and 360x740 DPR3 touch via CDP device emulation: single-column stack on mobile, scrollWidth == innerWidth on both classes, controls visible and operable.

openQuestions.title: Probe the real depth-sensing surface instead of only recommending
openQuestions.detail: Add an honest capability readout: navigator.xr presence, isSessionSupported('immersive-ar'), and an attempted requestSession with depthSensing (behind a user gesture) that reports the granted session.depthUsage/depthDataFormat/depthType or the exact failure — so the router's advice is paired with what this device actually grants. Degrade with a labelled unsupported state on desktop browsers without XR.

openQuestions.title: Record a telemetry assert after the primary action
openQuestions.detail: Call window.showcaseTelemetry?.assert after a select change confirms the snippet/matrix re-rendered, so the 2026-07 dead-page failure mode (parse error before telemetry init) can never again go unseen — and consider a beacon-friendly parse-level check for this page.

openQuestions.title: Confirm Chromium 139's shipped IDL naming on a real device
openQuestions.detail: The spec draft defines depthTypeRequest (sequence) and the readonly session.depthType; the page now teaches that shape. Cross-check Chromium 139's xr_session_init IDL on source.chromium.org and a real ARCore device to confirm the shipped member name matched the draft at that milestone.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live region announcing updated results after select change
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic result updates to assistive tech via a polite live region tied to the control that changes them.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The recommendation pane is now aria-live=polite and the selects/table carry meaningful accessible names, so recommendation changes are announced.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP-driven select change re-rendered snippet/matrix/stats inside the live region; computed roles/labels checked in DOM.

guidanceConsulted.query: WCAG contrast for button pressed state dark background inline code chip
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Every text/background pair must meet WCAG AA; re-check pairs whenever a surface color is overridden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Replaced the emerald-on-emerald td.best pair with black-on-emerald (~5.1:1) using only design-system variables.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Computed style probe: color rgb(0,0,0) on background rgb(10,143,92).

summary: Repaired in place with the smallest patches: the HTML-entity-escaped inline script was rewritten as real JS (page was dead with a parse-time SyntaxError; now loads and updates cleanly with zero non-environmental console errors), the 404 ChromeStatus id was corrected to 5074096916004864, the taught API surface was aligned with the spec's depthTypeRequest sequence plus session.depthType read-back, the invisible emerald-on-emerald matrix cells became AA black-on-emerald, and the revealed table overflow was contained with pane-local scrolling. Verified via CDP in headless Chromium 141 on desktop and mobile viewports with driven interactions and screenshots. Remaining honest gaps: no real XR probe, no telemetry assert.
